description:
A team workspace for running AI coding agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees, live diff review, GitHub integration, and mobile access.

Lody is a team agent workspace: share coding agents with your team on phone and desktop. Shared sessions, live diffs, and one control plane keep your team and agents in sync.
Run agents in parallel with isolated Git worktrees and live diff review, use subscriptions you already have with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, and any agent that speaks ACP, manage the same control plane in the terminal with CLI commands, and ship together in one workspace with shared sessions, usage by member, and PR, CI, and merge status in-session.
Version 0.88.1
✨ New
- Session results in the @ mention menu now default to the current project, with a temporary switch to all projects when needed, making relevant sessions easier to find (#109).
- Desktop now requires selecting a machine before an Agent can be chosen, with clearer guidance throughout the flow (#151).
🐛 Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed an issue where the first message in a child tab could be dropped, remain stuck on "Syncing," or prevent the tab from closing (#141).
- Fixed overlap between side conversations and file or diff previews (#135).
- Improved data isolation in the desktop onboarding tour so the demo cannot accidentally access real workspace data (#136).
- Project terminals no longer inherit internal environment variables used by Electron startup and the credential proxy (#122).
- Completed English and Chinese translations for target status, task saving, and Windows Git diagnostics, and restored the missing Agent name (#59).
- Thanks to @27Aaron, @ImSingee, and @natsustan for their public contributions to this release.
